title: Sentences used in the speech-to-song illusion: Comparisons of acoustic vowel space
underlying_source: 77 spoken-sentence recordings selected from previously assembled speech-to-song stimuli, principally audiobook-derived material
annotation_provenance: Study reports all recordings manually segmented in Praat with word/phoneme/vowel TextGrid tiers and acoustic formant analysis
reason: Manual segmentation is strong, but the underlying speech is not primary research production collected by the authors: the article states the stimuli were gathered from audiobooks / an existing UvA Music Cognition collection. This conflicts with the database exclusion of third-party media collections and secondary reuse. Do not ingest the recordings or measurements into core.
